capability.title: Menu Page Header
capability.description: Menu page opener with an eyebrow, the page headline, a description, and a row of highlight pills; it owns the menu page h1.
useWhen: The menu page needs its single h1 and a short introduction above the catalog
A few scan-friendly highlights should sit under the menu headline
avoidWhen: The page already has an opener or h1
The menu page needs filtering or sorting rather than an introduction
